title: Kids Shoe Size Chart & Converter
metaDescription: Comprehensive kids shoe size conversion chart covering toddler, youth, and junior footwear across US, UK, and European standards.
directAnswer: Kids' shoe sizing spans two distinct phases: toddler sizes (1C to 10C) and youth sizes (10.5C to 3Y, transitioning into adult sizing at 4Y). To convert US kids' sizes to EU, a US 10C equals an EU 27, while a youth 1Y equals an EU 32 (approximately 20 cm foot length).

faq.question: When do kids' shoe sizes transition into adult sizes?
faq.answer: Kids' youth sizes transition into adult sizing at size 4Y, where a youth 4Y is equivalent to a Men's 4.0 or Women's 5.5.

faq.question: How often should you check children's shoe size?
faq.answer: Children under age 3 should be measured every 2 to 3 months; kids aged 4 to 8 should be measured every 4 to 6 months.

faq.question: What does the 'C' and 'Y' mean in kids' shoe sizes?
faq.answer: 'C' stands for Child (toddler and young kids, sizes 1C to 13C), and 'Y' stands for Youth (older kids, sizes 1Y to 7Y).
